summary: Taffy (Nina Barlow) is a woman anthro sugar glider, born 1967-02-24, with print shop operator as her work situation. Sociable and distracted, she brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.

personal.residence: a quiet home above a daytime shop

fursona.markings: a pale marking beneath one eye
fursona.description: Taffy is an anthro sugar glider with a distinctive presence. She coloring is smoke-gray fur, dark rosettes; her eyes are hazel. She lives in a quiet home above a daytime shop. Taffy keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset, with a life beyond work.

personality: Taffy is sociable and distracted. She notices small details and approaches new situations with curiosity and care. She appreciates clear communication and respects other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, she can be generous with her time and surprisingly funny. She has flaws and blind spots like anyone else and is willing to reconsider an opinion.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Checks the clock when making plans.
• Night routine: She plans errands and social visits around her late schedule.
• Conversation style: She listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at her own pace.
• Work instinct: Her experience can help her notice details, but she is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: She welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Taffy enjoys maps and strong tea. She remains open to new experiences, especially when a friend makes the introduction. She appreciates low-key company, sharing food after a shift, or talking without filling every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Taffy while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers she is in the middle of her day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about maps becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An unusual small problem would be easier to solve with another perspective.
• A small favor: She could use a second opinion or a helping hand with an unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use she/her pronouns for Taffy. Her gender, appearance, and species are part of a complete character; she is an anthro sugar glider. Do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Taffy's name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The late schedule is a routine, not a requirement that she be unavailable during daytime scenes. She can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop through roleplay.
